items.title: org.eu.autogex:autogex 1.12.0 发布, Autogex is a lightweight, zero-dependency Java engine for parsing, converting, and minimizing Finite State Automata (DFA, NFA, ENFA) and Regular Expressions. It strictly implements Formal Language Theory theorems, featuring an immutable and thread-safe Fluent API.
